Beau Bayh

Democratic candidate for Secretary of State, Indiana · Open seat

Attorney at an Indianapolis-based law firm; U.S. Marine Corps veteran

Beau Bayh is an Indianapolis attorney and Marine Corps veteran. He is the son of former Indiana Gov. and U.S. Sen. Evan Bayh and the grandson of former U.S. Sen. Birch Bayh. He announced his campaign in October 2025, has never run for office before, and won the Democratic nomination for Indiana Secretary of State at the state party convention on June 6, 2026, taking 61% of delegate votes over Blythe Potter.

Where Bayh stands

Audit of the Secretary of State's office
Says he would order an independent audit of the office on his first day, to examine spending under current Secretary Diego Morales and decide who should be held accountable.
State contracts and campaign donors
Has pledged that no donor to his campaign will get a state contract. Says the office should stop giving no-bid contracts to campaign donors.
Office spending and hiring
Says he would end the hiring of officials' family members, spending public money on luxury vehicles, and travel with no explanation of who paid or why.
Voter ID
Supports Indiana's current voter ID law. Said at the Oct. 22 debate that Indiana has done a fairly good job of identifying voter fraud.
Straight-ticket voting
Wants the Indiana General Assembly to end straight-ticket voting.
Debate access for all candidates
Called for all four Secretary of State candidates to be invited to the televised FOX59/CBS4 debate, not just the two who met the 10% polling threshold.
